title: PhysicsOutput
description: Simulation outputs from physics_worker (Modules 1–4): natural cubic splines, GDD accumulation, soil water balance RK4, and Newton-Raphson irrigation trigger.

parcel_id.description: Unique parcel identifier matching the input ClimateSoilBundle.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of computation completion.

source.description: Origin of input data used for physics computation.

spline_result.description: Module 1: Gap-filled NDVI trajectory generated via natural cubic spline (TDMA).

ndvi_filled.description: Continuous NDVI values with all cloud gaps interpolated. No null or NaN allowed.

used_tdma.description: True if solved with explicit Thomas algorithm (TDMA), verified against SciPy.

gdd_result.description: Module 2: Thermal time accumulation via composite Simpson 1/3 integration.

t_base_c.description: Base temperature in °C used for integration threshold.

gdd_accumulated.description: Cumulative Growing Degree Days (°C-days) over time. Monotonically non-decreasing.

water_balance.description: Module 3: Daily soil moisture storage W(t) computed via explicit RK4 numerical integration.

w_mm.description: Root zone available water storage in mm over Zr=600mm. Invariant: 0 <= W(t).

etc_mm.description: Crop evapotranspiration under water stress in mm/day.

drainage_mm.description: Deep percolation drainage in mm/day when W > field_capacity_mm.

irrigation_trigger.description: Module 4: Newton-Raphson trigger timing when W(t) drops to critical threshold Wcrit.

t_star_days.description: Exact day offset when irrigation is required (f(t*)=0), or null if threshold is never crossed.

delta_i_mm.description: Recommended irrigation depth in mm = field_capacity_mm - critical_water_mm.

reason.description: Diagnostic reason if t_star_days is null (e.g. 'W_never_crosses_Wcrit', 'W_already_below_Wcrit').
